PullRequest.Title: agentHost: deduplicate plugin command completions
PullRequest.Body:

Stacked on #343899. The base is deliberately its topic branch; retarget to `main` after that prerequisite merges.

### Changes

SDK session plugin listings can omit the `directSourceId` retained by global installation records. The previous merge treated these as separate installations, so `/plugin update` and `/plugin uninstall` incorrectly hid a uniquely installed local plugin such as `session-timeline` as ambiguous.

- Recover the canonical installation identity when the session entry matches exactly one global installation by name and marketplace, retaining live enablement and managed-policy state.
- Deduplicate repeated inventory entries without collapsing distinct direct source IDs or marketplaces. Unidentified session aliases of multiple real installations do not invent additional installations or overwrite their individual state.
- Consistently offer qualified marketplace specs, such as `box@claude-plugins-official`, for enable/disable as well as update/uninstall. The redundant forwarded copies that produced bare marketplace aliases are addressed by #343899; genuinely separate local and marketplace installations remain distinct.
- Add cold/live inventory and completion regressions, including ambiguous direct sources, disabled installations, policy state, completion labels, and same-named plugins from different marketplaces.

### Validation

- `npm run build-fast -- --client-only` — passed.
- `./scripts/test.sh --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/copilotSlashCommandCompletionProvider.test.ts --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/copilotAgent.test.ts --grep "CopilotSlashCommandCompletionProvider|[Pp]lugin" --reporter dot` — passed, 103 tests.
- `npm run typecheck-client` — passed.
- `npm run eslint -- src/vs/platform/agentHost/node/copilot/copilotAgent.ts src/vs/platform/agentHost/node/copilot/copilotSlashCommandCompletionProvider.ts src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/copilotAgent.test.ts src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/copilotSlashCommandCompletionProvider.test.ts` — passed.
- `git diff --check` and commit hygiene — passed.

The original duplication was diagnosed in running Insiders with dbgjs. This patched build has not been exercised in a live window; full integration/smoke suites were not run. Worktree dependency bootstrap initially encountered registry authentication (`E401`) in extension installation; a root-only installation subsequently allowed all checks above to pass without changing registry credentials.

Scenarios.Scenario: Request `/plugin enable`, `disable`, `update`, `remove`, or `uninstall` completions for a live Copilot chat
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The completion request awaits the global plugin inventory RPC, then the live session plugin inventory RPC, then reconciles both inventories, then awaits session customization discovery before candidates can be returned. The diff changes only the in-process reconciliation and candidate naming; both RPCs and customization discovery were already on this path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: List the shared/global installed plugin inventory through client.rpc.plugins.list()
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Exactly one RPC per matching completion request, independent of G
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same global plugin-list RPC occurred once on this path before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must complete before reconciliation and completion candidates can be produced

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: List the live session's installed plugins through session.rpc.plugins.list()
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Exactly one RPC per matching completion request when a live session exists, independent of S
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same session plugin-list RPC occurred once on this path before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Runs after the global list and must complete before reconciliation

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Settle plugin/customization discovery and refresh MCP discovery while resolving session customizations
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One customization resolution per matching completion request; warm controller state can reuse settled discovery, while MCP discovery refresh behavior is unchanged
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The provider already resolved session customizations after listing plugins.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Occurs after inventory reconciliation and must complete before plugin candidates are returned

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Global installed-plugin count G and live-session plugin count S. The new identity recovery scans G entries for each session entry lacking a directSourceId, so local reconciliation is O(G*S) in the worst case; candidate construction remains linear in the reconciled inventory. Installed-plugin inventories are realistically small, so the added comparisons are bounded and not evidenced as user-visible beside the unchanged RPC/discovery latency.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The global and session plugin-list RPCs are awaited sequentially. Session customization work follows inventory reconciliation and may internally await cached/in-flight sync and discovery work in parallel. The diff neither adds concurrency nor changes this scheduling.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Installed inventories are uncached on both cold and repeated completion requests before and after the diff. The changed merge creates only request-local Map/Set state. Customization controllers retain discovery state, but that lifecycle is unchanged. No new cache, retained key set, or negative-cache behavior is introduced.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence in the O(G*S) local scan and in the unchanged sequential boundary call path, based on the changed loop and traced provider callbacks. High confidence that no expensive boundary or repeated boundary fan-out was introduced.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact installed-plugin counts and local comparison timings are not measured. However, the changed nested scan operates over installed inventories rather than marketplace catalogs, and no evidence establishes realistically large G or S; the unchanged IPC and discovery operations dominate likely latency.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The diff adds a worst-case quadratic in-memory identity lookup, but realistic inventory cardinality does not establish concrete latency, CPU, or GC impact, and all expensive boundary calls retain their previous cardinality and placement.

Scenarios.Scenario: Request plugin completions before a live SDK session exists (cold/provisional chat)
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The request awaits one global plugin inventory RPC, returns that inventory without running the changed live-session merge, and then resolves session customizations before formatting completion candidates. The changed reconciliation loop is bypassed entirely.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: List the shared/global installed plugin inventory through client.rpc.plugins.list()
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One RPC per matching completion request
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must finish before candidates can be generated

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Resolve and settle session customization discovery
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One resolution per matching completion request, with existing warm discovery reuse
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must finish before candidates are returned

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Global installed-plugin count G controls linear candidate filtering and formatting; the diff only changes marketplace candidate text selection by a constant amount per plugin.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One plugin-list RPC is awaited before customization resolution. Customization settling may internally parallelize its existing sync/discovery operations. The diff does not alter concurrency or backpressure.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The global plugin list is uncached on repeated requests before and after the diff. The new Map and merge are not allocated because there is no live session. Existing customization discovery state may be warm; no cache behavior changed.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence because `_listInstalledPlugins` returns immediately when no live session exists and the provider's only changed work is constant per marketplace candidate.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Underlying IPC and discovery duration varies by environment, but the diff does not add, move, or multiply either boundary.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Cold completion boundary count, serialization scale, and critical-path ordering are unchanged; qualified marketplace strings add only negligible per-candidate allocation.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all four changed files and all diff pages. Traced live and cold plugin-completion paths, including IPC and filesystem/customization boundaries, cache behavior, effective cardinality, and concurrency. The only new scaling mechanism is an in-memory O(G*S) lookup over realistically small installed-plugin inventories; it does not meet the evidence threshold for concrete user-visible impact, and no expensive boundary was introduced or amplified. No findings were submitted.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
